conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the Partnership legal form. A general partnership of two or more persons.

profileFields.label: Registration number
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Share capital
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Partner
roles.description: Owns a share of the partnership.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the Partnership name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in FSM Registrar of Corporations and follows Micronesia's naming rules.

setupSteps.title: Prepare the Partnership documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs. The Registrar of Corporations website at roc.doj.gov.fm returned HTTP 503 when checked, so the national government portal is listed as the registry source.

setupSteps.title: Register the Partnership
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as FSM Registrar of Corporations requires. The company exists once the register enters it.

setupSteps.title: Register the Partnership for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Department of Finance and Administration for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with FSM Social Security Administration for payroll and social contributions.

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with FSM Registrar of Corporations, then file it and keep the company record current.

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with FSM Registrar of Corporations, the deadline and whether an audit is required.

obligations.title: Partnership tax return
obligations.description: File the partnership's information return with Department of Finance and Administration. The partners report their share on their own returns.

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Department of Finance and Administration and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through FSM Social Security Administration. Check the rates and dates.

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with FSM Registrar of Corporations.

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to FSM Registrar of Corporations, then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.
